resources.string: Try a short sound request from your charging case.

Experimental, AirPods Pro 3 case only. Windows tests were silent; Android playback is unverified. Pause media and recordings, put both earbuds in your case and keep them out of your ears. Keep other cases away. Finding a nearby case does not link it to your saved AirPods. Stop is requested automatically after two seconds; the case may ignore it.
This is my case, with both earbuds inside and out of my ears.
